dedupe_keys.name: gestion de incidentes cyber security incidents handled by colcert colombia open data

description: ColCERT, Colombia's national cyber emergency response team within the Ministry of Information and Communication Technologies, publishes its incident management records as open data, alongside a data story on digital security and a list of indicators of compromise. The dataset read on 2026-09-28 through the open data portal's API holds 3,997 incident requests with the request date, the order of the affected entity (national or territorial), its sector, region and department, the classification in the incident taxonomy, the incident type and its importance, updated on 16 September 2026 and released under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licence. Coverage is national, for incidents reported to ColCERT. Access is free download or API. Caveats: records are reported cases, not all attacks, entities are anonymised to sector and region, and taxonomy categories must be read from ColCERT's guidance. It supports time series and sector breakdowns of cyber incidents for threat context in studies of Colombian critical infrastructure. Related records: data-nkcki-russia-cyber-incident-weekly-statistics and data-kz-cert-incident-statistics are comparable national CERT statistics.
